localizedText.zh-CN: 构建JSDoc与HIA集成文档
localizedText.en: Build JSDoc and HIA integration documentation

localizedText.zh-CN: 从配置或直接输入建立请求并运行真实JSDoc，加载所选受信插件与模板。
localizedText.en: Build a request from configuration or direct inputs and run actual JSDoc with selected trusted plugins and templates.

localizedText.zh-CN: hia-jsdoc --config hia-jsdoc.config.json
localizedText.en: hia-jsdoc --config hia-jsdoc.config.json

localizedText.zh-CN: 配置模式非空out-dir、include-pattern与mode覆盖原值，空字符串保留配置。
localizedText.en: In config mode nonempty out-dir, include-pattern and mode values override configuration; empty strings retain it.

localizedText.zh-CN: workspace-root和位置输入仅用于直接模式；配置模式忽略它们。
localizedText.en: workspace-root and positional inputs apply to direct mode only; config mode ignores them.

localizedText.zh-CN: 配置路径相对调用目录，配置工作区相对配置目录；直接工作区相对调用目录，输出相对工作区。
localizedText.en: Config paths use cwd and configured workspaces use the config directory; direct workspaces use cwd and output uses the workspace.

localizedText.zh-CN: 运行真实JSDoc并写运行配置及工件，失败时可能已写文件，旧产物可能保留。所选插件与模板执行本地代码，其网络能力需单独授权。
localizedText.en: Run actual JSDoc and write runtime config and artifacts; failure may leave files and prior artifacts may remain. Selected plugins and templates execute local code, with network capabilities requiring separate authorization.

localizedText.zh-CN: Node严格解析先于帮助，未知开关或缺值返回1；重复带值选项取最后值，--后作为位置输入。
localizedText.en: Node strict parsing precedes help; unknown switches or missing values exit 1. Repeated value options use the last value, and tokens after -- are positional inputs.

localizedText.zh-CN: 默认插件和主题从工作区node_modules读取，须预先安装匹配包；模式控制HIA集成与主题，上游默认模板仍可能写HTML。
localizedText.en: Default plugins and themes resolve from workspace node_modules and require matching installed packages. Mode selects HIA integration and theme behavior; the upstream default template may still write HTML.
